Chapter 18 · The Journey Continues
A Note From The Heart

FOR MY FAVOURITE PERSON.

Dear Munmun,

2021, class 9. Hum ek hi classroom mein baithe the, bas dost nahi bane. Tum ek taraf, main doosri taraf, aur beech mein ek anjaani si doori. Kabhi socha nahi tha ki wahi ‘classmate’ ek din meri sabse achhi dost banegi.

Phir October 2026 aaya, aur October theory sach ho gayi. Hum Instagram par dobara mile. Ek ‘hi’, phir ek baat, aur dekhte hi dekhte pata chala ki hamari sochne ki, hasne ki aur raaton ko jaagne ki aadatein itni milti hain ki lagta hai hum saalon se ek dusre ko jaante hain.

Tum Harry Potter ki duniya, raat ke aasmaan, taaron aur galaxies mein jaise apna ghar dhoondhti ho. Aur jab tum mujhe pyaar se ‘Cardiomyocyte’ bulati ho, toh lagta hai us cell ko sach mein dil dhadkane ka ek nayi wajah mil gayi.

Bas hamesha aisi hi rehna, Munmun. Jaisi ho, waisi. 18 ki ho gayi ho, par wo pagalpan kabhi mat chhodna.

Happy 18th Birthday, Munmun!

With all my love,Shubham · your Cardiomyocyte
